name: prep-compact
description: Audit in-flight session state before a context-compacting step truncates history. Saves what would be lost (commits real work locally, syncs stale plan and state files, captures background output, notes chat-only decisions), asking first only for anything destructive, outward-facing, or against a repo rule, then produces a copy-paste /compact message plus a queue-able follow-up that chains the next action when compact finishes. Portable across Agent Skills hosts — compacting is a general concept, not Claude-specific.
